connectHelp: Connect the Spotify account whose playback viewers will queue onto. It authorizes against your app above. The refresh token is stored encrypted and never shown back.
connectNeedsApp: Add your Spotify app above first.
connectedHelp: Your Spotify account is connected. The token lives encrypted server-side and is never shown back here.
disconnectBody: Bagel will stop accessing your Spotify account. Song requests will be unavailable until you reconnect.
reconnect: Your Spotify grant is missing a permission song requests needs.
scopeGap: Your Spotify connection is missing a permission song requests needs. Reconnect to grant it.
title: Connection
grantRevoked: Spotify no longer accepts this connection, so song requests are paused. Reconnect to resume them.
